prompt_key_instructions: Copy quotes character for character, 8 to 60 words, never across a [...] gap, and give the page URL from its header line.
At least one quote must contain the place name and a year in the window (or come from a page published then). Writing the name into the claim is not enough.
The claim says nothing its quotes don't: no added causes, numbers, names or dates. Keep the quote's tense (planned stays planned). Never move a year or place from one sentence onto another.
Change-kind glossary from ADR-003: urban_growth means cleared or built over, so never claim finished buildings. water_loss includes land reclamation. In deserts, new neighbourhoods show as greening.
LOCAL changes need a named site. A trend across a neighbourhood, town or region is not a cause for a small patch.
'Cause unknown' (an empty list) is a correct, respected answer. Never fill a gap from your own knowledge.
code_checks: A quote is kept only if verify.excerpt_in_page passes on that URL's recorded text and it is at most 600 characters.
A quote that neither names the place nor fits the years is dropped.
A claim is kept only if at least one kept quote passes both names_place and in_years, and the claim is at most 240 characters.
TR-6: every number in the claim must appear in its own quotes.
Confidence comes from verify.confidence over the chapter's used sources. Authority comes from verify.authority(domain).
weaknesses: Rate limits dominate the numbers. llm.py retries 429s inside the budget, so a busy quota both burns calls (up to 3 per change) and quietly turns changes into cause_unknown. Recall swung from 0.29 to 0.86 across runs, mostly for this reason.
Results vary from run to run even at temperature 0: the Paradise and Lake Mead claims came and went.
There is no code check for TR-5 itself. Moving a date between sentences of the same page (Palm Jumeirah 'by 2007') passes every code check. Only a person or a separate checker call catches it.
Summerlin was missed in every run. The model will not tie 'Summerlin began to take shape in 1990' to the desert greening, even with the ADR-003 hint.
For local changes the model makes the scope call. Code cannot tell whether a named site covers the detected patch.
retrieved_at is the time explain() ran, because the recorded pages carry no fetch time.
The spike points llm.PROMPTS_DIR at its own prompts folder at run time, because llm.load_prompt only reads that one folder. Promoting it would move the prompt into backend/app/agent/prompts/.
